nt, click a row to jump straight to it, ten switchable looks including four light ones
# dsh-prompt-bar
中文
This plugin lets you see (and copy) the first prompt you sent in a DSH agent session at a glance, wi
th a collapsible panel listing every prompt you have sent. Designed to be minimal! Works with any DS
H client that shows the Web GUI.
## Screenshots
**1 — Collapsed bar.** At the top of the Chat (对话) tab, one pinned row shows the session's first pro
mpt — here `hello` — prefixed by its ordinal and a `首条提问` ("first prompt") tag, with a copy icon and
an expand icon on the right. The chat bubble below it (`hello`, sent 05:19) is the normal DSH conve
rsation flow: the bar sits above the conversation and, by design, never scrolls away, no matter how
he bar sits above the conversation and, by design, never scrolls away, no matter how far you scroll.
**2 — Expanded panel.** Clicking the expand icon opens a panel directly under the bar, titled `全部提问
· 共 3 条` ("all prompts · 3 total") with a × close button. It lists exactly the three prompts the use
r sent — `hello` (05:19, 5 characters), `今天的中东局势如何?` (10 characters), `今天的石油价格如何?` (10 characters) —
each row numbered and timestamped with its own copy icon. Model answers are not listed: the long an
swer about the Mideast ceasefire visible below the panel is part of the normal chat, simply pushed d
own while the panel is open (it expands inline instead of floating, so nothing is ever hidden behind
it). The footer spells out the interaction rules: `Esc 收起` / `点击面板外的区域同样收起` (press Esc or click any
where outside the panel to collapse), `复制 = 原文写入剪贴板` (copy puts the raw prompt text on the clipboard
ere outside the panel to collapse), `复制 = 原文写入剪贴板` (copy puts the raw prompt text on the clipboard).
[该节后续省略]
## Usage
| Action | Result |
| Bar right, 2nd icon (box with down arrow) | Expand the full-prompt panel; the icon stays lit while

it is open |
| Click the same icon again | Collapse |
| × at the right of the panel header | Collap

se |
| Click anywhere outside the panel (rest of DSH, message area, composer…) | Collapse |
| Press

`Esc` | Collapse |
| Copy icon on the bar | First prompt's raw text goes to the clipboard; the icon

ticks to a check mark |
| Hover a panel row and click its small copy icon | That prompt's raw text g

oes to the clipboard |
| Click a panel row (anywhere but its copy icon) | The panel collapses and th
e conversation jumps to that prompt, a frame flashing around it; if it was folded out of the loaded
window, older history is paged in on the spot first (a short "loading" badge shows while it works) |
| Slider icon in the panel header (left of ×) | Open the appearance picker; click the same icon aga

in to close |
| Click a swatch in the appearance picker | The bar takes that look immediately — no r
estart — and the choice is remembered |
The panel lists only prompts **you** sent — injected context, wake-up context, time context and comp
act checkpoints are all excluded — oldest first; prompts later overwritten are dropped. Everything s
tays local: records live in `localStorage` under the session id, no network requests, no telemetry.
[该节后续省略]
## Installation
- In the plugin market (dshmarket), install `dsh-prompt-bar` with one click; or run `dsh plugin add

dsh-prompt-bar`.
- **After installing, restart the whole DSH application.** `Ctrl+R` / `F5` only rel
oad the page; the client module graph is fixed when the web service starts, so without a restart the

old code keeps running.
- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1` (developed and tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / DSH

unning.
- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.1` (developed and tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 / DSH Desktop 0.12.1).
## Known limitations
- **Old sessions (created before this plugin was installed): the first prompt may not come back.** T
his is a DSH-side limit, not a plugin bug: in long sessions, compaction prunes the bodies of very ol
d events out of the data the client can read. In that case the bar shows the oldest prompt that can
still be recovered, and an orange **Incomplete (不完整)** badge appears next to it (hover for the reaso
n). You can manually click **Load older** in that session, refreshing the bar's prompt record until
the session's true first prompt appears — once it does, the record is properly saved and never chang

es again (that is the first prompt in the theoretical sense).
- **Jumping hits the same boundary.**
Clicking a panel row jumps to that prompt in the conversation. If its body was already pruned by com
paction (only very old prompts get that treatment), there is no rendered position left to point at:
the bar shows a short notice instead of scrolling somewhere random. The same applies to a first prom
pt remembered from a session that predates the plugin, when its position was never recorded.
